evidence: bp-node.lisp:1255-1269 and bp-app.lisp:399-408 `(unless primary-condition ...)`: with a primary the physical release debt stays in carriers but the exit class is the primary's, unlike fnn-unwind-cleanups' escalation (cd4673a17). Plain unwind-protect release at bp-contact.lisp:56, bp.lisp:728, bp.lisp:808 (release follows owner/Store close in the same cleanup list), bp-node.lisp:535, bp-node.lisp:585 (handler-case error only). Low impact: one-shot CLI verbs exit right after.
fix: Route these through fnn-unwind-cleanups with independent release clauses.
title: BP outer served cleanups are hand-rolled and drop the cleanup condition when a primary exists; fnn-bps-release is called from plain unwind-protect at five more sites, and bp.lisp:808 skips the release when the Store close errors
